data.name: Football Chess
data.detailed_description:
Football Chess is a unique strategy game that combines the excitement of football with the depth of chess. Victory is not decided by quick reflexes, but by smart decisions. Every player on the pitch acts like a chess piece, and every move you make can change the outcome of the match.

Position your team carefully, predict your opponent's strategy, and build the perfect attacking play. Deliver the right pass, exploit gaps in the defense, and take the perfect shot to score. A single mistake can give your opponent the advantage.

Experiment with different formations, develop your own playstyle, and discover new tactics in every match. Balance attack and defense, outthink your rival, and claim victory through superior strategy.

Features

  • A unique blend of football and chess

  • Turn-based strategic matches where every move matters

  • Deep tactical gameplay focused on predicting your opponent

  • Create different formations and game plans

  • Easy to learn, challenging to master

  • Single-player and multiplayer modes

  • Every match offers new tactical possibilities

Step onto the pitch, make your move, and outsmart your opponent. In Football Chess, every pass is part of a plan, every shot is a calculated risk, and every goal is the reward for perfect strategy.
